The beart consists of 20 sheaves. Ten sheaves are first placed standing against each other five on each side. Then three sheaves are placed in openings left by the other sheaves, to strengthen it. title: seamsóg
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     wood-sorrel
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     seamsógaí, stories about ghosts (AL); go leór seamsógaí an bealach seo fadó, a lot of pisreógaí in this part of the country long ago (Sb).

title: séan
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     deny
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     (it was in the prophecy) go séanfá do bhó héin ar do dhoras héin, that you would deny your own cow at your own door (people may do this to qualify for state assistance)

title: seánadh
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     see taisbeánadh infra.

title: searrach giorráin
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     male foal
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     s. lárach, female

title: seársadh
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     charge
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     thug sé oram seársadh, he made a charge at me (dog)

title: seid
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     shed

title: séin
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     chain
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     bhí séin leis, he had a chain (the vet.) for pulling calf

title: seisc
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     dry
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     bearach sheisc, heifer not in calf (MMt); seisc-capall, a dry mare (Sb).

title: seithe
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     hide
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     brógaí seitheadh, shoes made of raw hide

title: sídhtheamhail
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     subject to sudden storms (in October)

title: sinneán gaoithe
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     blast of wind
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     níl ann ach a' sinneán sin, his bark is worse than his bite

title: siod é
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     look at it over there

title: siol!
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     word used in chasing a hen out of cabbage plants (Breaffy); siola! siola! (Belcarra); siolaigí! to a number of geese (Keelogues) / ʃulǝg´ i: /.

title: sionnachóir lae
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     a pet day, i.e. one fine day during a spell of wet weather

title: siorlaidh
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     the Charolais

title: sláimín
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     sláimín go bhean, a slovenly untidy "clot" of a woman; sláimín Saturday, a lazy bad housekeeper who leaves all her work, washing etc., over till Saturday.

title: slám
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     slám olainne, a roll of wool tuairim 's punt (TmB); slám ceó, a piece of fog or foggy cloud.

title: sleámóg
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     a dark-brown seaweed which hangs in long snake-like strips like a skirt cut with scissors; sleámógaí were formerly used for kelp, and were put out as manure for potatoes (though they gave too much tops). In Conamara they are called stiallachaí according to MMt, and cabhrlleach according to MCd.

title: slód
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     tussock out of which sea-pink grows (Wm); PsC has doubts about this meaning. According to MCd the slód is where sea-birds build their nests.

title: slubaire
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     slubaire bróch, a person slovenly in speech and messy generally.

title: slubar
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     a mess of anything

title: sméadhamh
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     níl s. ar bith sa tinidh agad, your fire is nearly dead

title: sméarthacht
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     a' sméarthacht a cinn, rubbing her head, fingering her hair

title: smúitiú
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     tá an ghealach faoi smúitiú, scamall thart orthaí

title: smutú
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     ghá smutú, ghá mbriseadh (claidhmhtheachaí) (SOG); tá sí smutaí agad, you have it smashed (of spade that struck a stone) (MMt).

title: snaidhm buaic
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     binding of face of corpse

title: snámhán
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     a' ghaoth a' snámhán thart, the wind going round to another point

title: snámhtha
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     nach bhfuil sé snáfaí lé uisc' (an spéir thiar), the sky is full of rain on the way, coming

title: so-chaideartha
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     duine so-chaideartha, a harmless fellow.

title: sompla
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     a' sumpla bróch, nach fearr a' fear mise ná é? the dirty wretch, amn't I a better man than him

title: sónraidh
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     thóig mé sónraí dó, I observed it, took notice of it

title: sónta
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     fear sónta, fear a chreidfeadh chuile shórt (TmB). duine sónt', a youngster too obedient to everybody, doing what they tell him (MMt).

title: sóntaíl
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     an rud is measa bhí greamuithe go dhuine riamh a' tsóntaíl.

title: speinn
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     buailfidhear speinn air - na daoine maithe, he will become subject to, or under the spell of fairies (heard only once).

title: spéir-ghealaí
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     oíche spéir-ghealaí

title: spideóg
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     a' cathamh spideógaí

title: spleic
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     tilt
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     spleic ar a' tsíogán, lop-sided rick.

title: spot
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     spot

title: sraith
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     level ground
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     sra' ghainí, light loamy soil with sand through it (TmB); ar a' tSra' riabhach, n.loc., on the top of Cnoc a' tearmainn, ó thuaidh ón 'look-out' (an áit ar mharaigh fear go Chathánach an rón) (PsC).

title: stácadh
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     a' stácadh, ag ithe aibéil (AC); i n-amhrán:- Tá doiminic agus Seán ag goil stácadh dhá chathamh .i. dhá chathamh go dian (AOS).

title: stagger
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     te, (a' fás) is na biollaí, kills sheep, bruitheann sé iad (MCd)
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     bláth a' stagger, bláth buí; cailltear a' chaora; ar a' spot a gcaillfidhear í éiríonn sí bréan (Jn). Perh. the bulbous crowfoot is meant.

title: stanna
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     the difference between a stanna and a baraille is a' stanna mar seo  I  I , a' baraille mar seo  (  )

title: staoin-leic
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     name of a sloping flag

title: stealladh
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     kicking, lashing, i.e. horse kicking with both hind legs

title: stéig
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     snaidhm ar stéig was formerly the name given to appendicitis
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     snaidhm ar stéig

title: steig meig a dhéanamh de
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     to lay him out (for the count) (SBh).

title: stíoc
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     chuck to hens, but stíoc when calling chickens is the proper word to use

title: stiúir
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     bean gan chliú ná bád gan stiúir (sean-ocal); imeó' sí chuile áit, no control over her

title: stocaire
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     a cadger cadging for money or drink
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     níor tóigeadh ar stocaireacht (é)

title: stocán láidir go ghasúr
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     a strong sturdy stump of a lad

title: stráiméad
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     a big lazy fellow

title: stupannaí
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     pailing posts (?)

title: suanaí
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     níl ann ach suanaí, (tá sé) ciúin gan suim i gcaint aige; gan bheith a' caint

title: súgán
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     a shúgáin, addressing a young lad in depreciatory terms

title: suicín! suicín!
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     used to call a calf

title: suimplí
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     with s-leathan is the dialect form of the usual simplidhe.

title: súithche
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     soot

title: súmaire
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     súmaire doracha go dhuine, a sile fellow with no word in him, who won't speak to you. Is deas a' rud píosa cainte, níor mhol éinne riamh a' súmaire

title: tabhairt
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     a' tabhairt dó, hard at it (hay-making (ML); tá an traghan a' tabhairt dó, the corncrake is hard at it, singing away good and loud (MC).

title: taéradh
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     salutation
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     chuir sé taéradh oram, he saluted me, spoke to me in passing (Wm); chuir sé taéradh cainte air (TmB).

title: tais
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     ghost (of living person), wraith: chonnaic A. an fear beag agus bhí sé ag iarraidh breith air. Chonnaic sé aríst é beó

title: taisbeánadh
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     revelation, sign.

title: taithí
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     act of frequenting
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     tá sé a' taithí sa teach seo go mór .i. a ghoil ar chuairt ann go minic; is teann é an madadh geárr san áit a mbíonn a thaithí (sean-ocal) (MMt). Cf. D. s. v. madadh.

title: tálach
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     muscular pain in the wrist

title: tanaidh
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     the shallow water (ML); cf. amuich ar a' domhain, out on the deep

title: tara
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     cho dubh leis a' tara

title: tarraint
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     stammer, impediment of speech

title: te teann
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     rug siad ar a chéilí go te teann

title: téad
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     tá téad ar an asal agam, I have the ass tied by rope to stake out in the field (Sb); gamhain ar téad ní dheachaidh riamh 'un cinn (sean-ocal) (MCd), a staked calf never throve

title: teann
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     force, pressure
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     le teann a' ghálaidh, with the force of the wind; le teann uilc, from sheer badness (Sb); le teann na foladh, from the pressure of the blood; fua' sí siar ar theann an uisc', she went back in the teems of rain, when the rain was at its heaviest (ML).

title: teann fharaige
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     The Old Sea' is used in English in Belmullet for this part of the sea, and it has been suggested to me that formerly the sea did not come past the line between Cleggan Head and Áird Mhór.

title: teannta
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     a choinneál i n-a theannta, to keep it together (money), not to spend any of it

title: téigle
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     (tá sé) i n-a chalam téigle, it is perfectly calm (said of the sea on a fine day); stoirim shamhraidh ná téigle gimhridh níl aon tseasamh orthaí (sean-ocal) (MMt), a summer storm or a winter calm will not last long.

title: thoir dtuaidh
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     in the N. E.

title: tinn ar ghamhain
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     sick of calving

title: tiogainní
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     come on, I have heard teanamaí also used to address more than one person

title: tionnscain
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     begin, start
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     cé thionnscain é, who started it (fight)? (TmB); is tú a thionnscail a' troid (EOCn); v.n. a' tionnscaint.

title: tioscaire
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     níl ainntí ach tioscaire, rud beag óg

title: togha
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     act of picking (potatoes)
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     á dtogha, picking them (TmB) /a: dǝuwǝ /.

title: toghadóir
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     a picker (of potatoes)

title: tóin
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     tifí as tóin a chéilí, houses built one at the end of another

title: toirt gan tairbhe
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     applied to a person getting in one's way; such a person is said to be an-amscaí

title: toisigh
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     half-soles (of shoes)

title: tolladh
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     a' tolladh, butting with horns, "pucking" (of cattle).

title: tom
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     tom a' t-éideadh as an uisce caisc (Sb), dip the scapular in the holy water.

title: tonnc
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     a nudge, butt (from bull)

title: torabord
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     turbot, iasc mór leathan

title: trathailte
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     shivering wet
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     thainic sé isteach bog báite is é trathailtí.

title: tráthúil
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     duine tráthúil tíorthúil, fear cainteach fáiltiúil (TmB); ag innsean rudaí (go dhuine) a' dúil le go gcreidfeadh sé iad; bíonn níos mó ná an ceart ar siúl aige; ní chreidtear é a leath gon am (duine tráthúil) (bean AOS).

title: treall
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     a while of
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     treall cainte, treall gréine

title: tréamánta
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     focal atá tréamánta sa gcaint

title: tréamánta
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     duine tréamánta, a headstrong person

title: treóir
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     go múinfe tú treóir dúinn, give us guidance, direction, nuair a bhethá amú ar a' gcroc

title: trioll
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     in idiom thit a' trioll ar a' treall agam, I was completely non-plussed

title: triomaigh
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     níor thriomaigh sé ar aon charraic ariamh (an foightheach), always in the water, never seen on land or on a rock (great northern diver)

title: triúr
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     tá siad triúr Gallachúraí ann, there are three of those Gallaghers (EOM); muid triúr, the three of us (ML). Cf. libh-se ceathar, with the four of you (ML).

title: troilithe
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     spent, worn, senile
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     tá sé i n-a shean-fhear troilithe, he is a shaky old man.

title: troisc
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     starve
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     throiscfeá .i. ní shaothróchá orad is thabharfadh biadh agus beatha duit.

title: trom-chúis
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     le trom-chúis adúirt sé é, for fun, humbugging (bean AOS); trom-chúis - grataí magaidh (AL). Contrast D.

title: truipéad
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     an edible seaweed

title: truisle
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     baineadh truisle as, he fell, stumbled

title: trumpa
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     a tramp;  (rakish)

title: tseof! tseof!
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     call word used for sheep

title: tuagh cheatha
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     rainbow; an bun (Jn); i n-a lúbán (SBh).

title: tuar
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     causing
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     a' tuar aicíde, causing or generating disease (such as a rubbish dump)

title: tuata
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     tuata a rinní é .i. fear gan cheird

title: tuatach
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     ceárdaí tuatach, one who does not have his trade, a "gobbawn" tradesman.

title: tugthaí uam
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     taken from me

title: tuit
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     settle
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     fan go dtite siad, wait till they settle down (before you go head them) - said of freshly made cocks of hay.

title: túnaois
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     thug sé túnaois dó, a small beating, black-eye, perhaps (TmB); cf. Béaloideas, xvii, 257 (six lines from bottom): bhuail siad túnaois mhaith orthú, from Pádraig Mac Meanaman, An Claigeann, in aice le Baile Chruaich.

title: tur
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     dry, without condiment

title: tur
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     fataí tura, gan bainne gan im gan uibheachaí

title: turachán
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     níl ann ach turachán, páiste (ná colapach) nach mbeith aon fhás faoi

title: turlainn
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     rocky foreshore, stone beach
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     also applied to the loose stoes half-way up Croagh Patrick (ML); clocha turlainne, beach stones (PAG).

title: turus tuaithbheal
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     turas a chuireas daoiní ar dhaoiní eile le spit

title: tutáil
meaning: Ciall nó Míniú (BÉARLA):     impatience, fussiness (of guide on the Reek) (ML). Add to Éigse xi, 245.

title: uaigneach
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     áit uaigneach, a place full of ghosts

title: uain
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     tá lot ar uain a cinn, there is a wound on the back of her head.

title: uair
usage: Sampla(í) Úsáide:     ar uair an dó dhéag, at twelve o' clock.
